test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

a. Freedom of thought and expression are fundamental human rights.

b. There are two important human rights.

c. Through good deeds, one can gain dignity.

d. Everyone has the inherent right to be treated with dignity and courtesy at all times.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph begins with the importance of dignity and respect for all individuals.
 
• **Sentence D is the first sentence** as it introduces the idea of inherent dignity:
 
 
• "Everyone has the inherent right to be treated with dignity and courtesy at all times."
 
 
 
• **Sentence C follows** as it expands on how dignity can be earned:
 
 
• "Through good deeds, one can gain dignity."
 
 
 
• **Sentence B comes next** as it generalizes the concept to human rights:
 
 
• "There are two important human rights."
 
 
 
• **Sentence A is the last** as it specifies the fundamental rights:
 
 
• "Freedom of thought and expression are fundamental human rights."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **DCBA**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Everyone has the inherent right to be treated with dignity and courtesy at all times. Through good deeds, one can gain dignity. There are two important human rights. Freedom of thought and expression are fundamental human rights."
